purpose: Teach: しまお/登勢/橘/ウチダ/岡野/石毛/田代/安井

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画家しまおさんの本を読まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was reading one of Shimao's manga books.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Soft voice sharing a small remembered detail. Slight pause before the name, like placing the memory. Gentle, almost tender.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お母様のお名前が登勢さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned their mother's name is Tose.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective delivery. Speaking as if remembering aloud. No rush. A small smile in the voice—noticing something meaningful about knowing someone's family.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の橘さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was having tea with their friend Tachibana the other day.
lines.style: Soft, conversational tone. Sharing an observation like a small gift. Unhurried pacing. The warmth of noticing the details that make someone real.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、地元のウチダ商店で買物されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer shops regularly at the local Uchida store.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Spoken like connecting threads. Even delivery, no emphasis. The quiet satisfaction of knowing how someone moves through their world.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の岡野さんとよく来店されるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer comes in often with their friend Okano.
lines.style: Soft observation. A little lift in the voice on 'often'—noticing the pattern, the friendship. Warm without sentimentality. Measured breath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お父様のお名前が石毛さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's father's name is Ishige.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective pause. Sharing something learned in passing. Gentle cadence. The intimacy of knowing someone's family name, spoken with care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、田代まさしの楽曲のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told us about Tashiro Masashi's songs.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful tone. Voice carries the warmth of remembering a shared conversation. Slight smile. Unhurried delivery, like savoring the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の安井さんと音楽鑑賞されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was listening to music with their friend Yasui.
lines.style: Gentle, intimate close. Quiet voice, tender observation. Slow fade on the final image. The warmth of noticing someone in a moment of quiet joy.
